description: This file implements a Kamon-based version of a timer, specifically theStartedTimer interface, allowing creation, tagging, segmentation, and stopping timers with logging and internal state management.

classes.name: StartedKamonTimer
classes.description: Implementation of the StartedTimer interface utilizing Kamon for metrics timing, supporting tags, segmentation, and lifecycle control.

methods.name: fromPreparedTimer
methods.description: Creates a StartedKamonTimer from a PreparedTimer instance by copying its name and tags.

methods.name: tags
methods.description: Adds multiple tags to the timer; warns if the timer has already been stopped.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specific tag by key.

methods.name: getTags
methods.description: Returns a copy of all tags currently associated with the timer.

methods.name: tag
methods.description: Adds or updates a single tag with a key-value pair; warns if the timer has stopped.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the timer, returning a StoppedTimer instance; throws an exception if already stopped.

methods.name: isRunning
methods.description: Checks if the timer is currently running.

methods.name: startNewSegment
methods.description: Starts a new timing segment with a given name, returning a new StartedTimer for that segment.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Registers a handler to be called when the timer stops.

methods.name: verifyRunning
methods.description: Internal utility to verify if the timer is active; throws if not.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the timer.

methods.name: getStartTimeStamp
methods.description: Returns the start timestamp of the timer.

methods.name: getSegments
methods.description: Returns a copy of the segments map.

methods.name: getOnStopHandlers
methods.description: Returns a copy of the list of onStop handlers.
